---
name: Shape proposal
about: A command shape or protected-path rule worth blocking
labels: enhancement
---

**The shape** (the pattern, and an example command it catches)

**The damage it does** (what goes wrong when an agent runs it unattended)

**The safe alternative** (what the refusal should tell the agent to do instead)

**False positives you know of** (what legitimate command this would also catch)
